label: GOD_4 HAS_WILL_1, from the willed joint-absence holder and at most one holder
description: Argument 5: a root consumer for #1941's argument B (conclusion fdd2b1cf), through STMT-GOD-HAS-WILL. Not a transcription. Establishes no premise. It shares the will-specific premise 090be689 (will follows intellect, through argument A) with 571e36f0 and 13338e9c, so it adds no independent support for the will-follows-intellect step. Its intellect input is the governor endpoint 0c27f65a (through argument 2 and 813a9181), not 29818edd: 0c27f65a is a one-witness endpoint, and with 0050b6ed and at most one holder, its premises jointly imply that every GOD_4 has that witness's intellect. It is an alternative intellect bundle, not a re-presentation of 571e36f0. It also says that the GOD_4 whose will 66aecdd7 asserts is the being whose giving of the actual contingents is willed rather than CHANCE_3 (one power). Sense bridges: fdd2b1cf's exercise-level willed giving (WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_2) passes to HAS_WILL_1 only through 65e0179f; the holder's PowerFor (POWER_FOR_VERSUS_ACTIVE_POWER_1) is joined to the active rational power (POWER_FOR_VERSUS_ACTIVE_POWER_2) only by fdd2b1cf itself, which asserts that one being has both. Omission models: without at most one holder (a willed non-GOD_4 holder beside a will-less GOD_4 holder), without 65e0179f, without 0050b6ed, without fdd2b1cf (#1941's chance rival).
